# Lab 18.2: Authorized Views

## What We Are Going to Do
Share the results of a view without giving users access to the source tables, using an authorized view.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create a private source dataset and a shared dataset.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq --location=US mk --dataset $PROJECT_ID:lab18_private
bq --location=US mk --dataset $PROJECT_ID:lab18_shared
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'CREATE TABLE lab18_private.users AS SELECT id, first_name, email, country, age FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users`'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Create a view in the shared dataset.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE VIEW lab18_shared.users_by_country AS
SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(AVG(age), 1) AS avg_age
FROM lab18_private.users
GROUP BY country;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[Console] Authorize the view.** Open `lab18_private → Sharing → Authorize views`. Add `lab18_shared.users_by_country`.

4. **[CLI] Give the analyst access to the shared dataset only.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false "GRANT \`roles/bigquery.dataViewer\` ON SCHEMA lab18_shared TO 'serviceAccount:$ANALYST'"
gcloud config set auth/impersonate_service_account $ANALYST
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'SELECT * FROM lab18_shared.users_by_country LIMIT 5'   # works
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'SELECT email FROM lab18_private.users LIMIT 5'         # Access Denied
gcloud config unset auth/impersonate_service_account</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[CLI] See the authorization in the dataset ACL.**

<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">

<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq show --format=prettyjson lab18_private | grep -B2 -A6 '"view"'</span>
</code></pre>

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| View | Reads private data on the user's behalf |
| User | Sees aggregates, never emails |
| Authorization | Stored in the source dataset's ACL |
| Edit risk | Changing the view SQL keeps the authorization |
